definitions.explanation: A medicine or substance that counteracts the effects of poison or a toxic substance.

examples.japanese: {解毒剤|げどくざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投与|とうよ}→投与：12894_touyo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
ヘビ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{噛|か}まれたら→噛む：01205_kamu⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{解毒剤|げどくざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: If you're bitten by a snake, you need an antidote right away.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{毒|どく}→毒：10052_doku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{解毒剤|げどくざい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦されていない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An antidote for that poison has not yet been developed.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{解毒|げどく}→解毒：14239_gedoku⟧ (detoxification) + ⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ (agent/medicine).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {解毒剤|げどくざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to take an antidote
- {解毒剤|げどくざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投与|とうよ}→投与：12894_touyo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to administer an antidote
- {解毒剤|げどくざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧: the antidote works/takes effect
- {解毒剤|げどくざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to develop an antidote

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{解毒|げどく}→解毒：14239_gedoku⟧: detoxification
- ⟦{毒|どく}→毒：10052_doku⟧: poison
- ⟦{中毒|ちゅうどく}→中毒：16558_chuudoku⟧: poisoning
- {血清|けっせい}: serum (e.g., anti-venom)

USAGE:
Appears in medical contexts and frequently in fiction — mystery novels, action movies, and fantasy stories. Also used figuratively for something that counteracts a negative influence.
